title: Reverse Carleson inequalities for weighted Fock spaces with $A_{\infty}$-type weights
summary: We characterize dominating sets for weighted Fock spaces $F^p_{α,w}$ induced by Muckenhoupt $A_{\infty}$ weights, which leads to a sufficient condition for reverse Carleson measures for the spaces $F^p_{α,w}$ with restricted $A_{\infty}$ weights. Applications to invertibility of Toeplitz operators, closed range property of Volterra operators, and atomic decomposition of $F^p_{α,w}$ are given.
